evals.prompt: Score three meeting action items. The extractor returned three, but two paraphrase the contract task and the budget task is missing.
evals.expected_output: Keep three predicted IDs. Assign two matches, one FP, one FN and 2/3 precision and recall. Expose the duplicate candidate and missed reference.

evals.prompt: On a photographed panel, finding A qualifies for defect 1 or 2, finding B only for 1. All qualifying pairs are human verified. A later image has a failed extraction and an empty human list.
evals.expected_output: Build one-to-one matching that assigns A to 2 and B to 1. Preserve the failure on the later image as unresolved instead of treating the prediction as empty.

evals.prompt: A model pairs requirements across languages. It sometimes treats a permission as an obligation. We need per-document compliance scores.
evals.expected_output: Define material attributes, measure hard-negative equivalence and held-out assignments separately from extraction, score accepted pairs in code, and mark candidate pending validation if evidence is missing.
